scenes.text: It's Monday morning. You sent nine roofing estimates last week. Two people wrote back.
The other seven are sitting in inboxes. Nobody follows up, because everyone's up on a roof.
Each estimate took hours to put together. And most of them just quietly expire.
The fix is a follow-up schedule that runs on its own, and stops the moment they reply.
Day two, Dana gets a quick check-in. Day five, photos of a similar roof. Day ten, one last nudge. She replies, and it comes straight to you.
Worth setting up this week. You already did the hard part.
Follow. I fix one business process like this every week.
